name: kavita
summary: [Kavita](https://github.com/Kareadita/Kavita) is a fast, feature rich, cross platform reading server. Built with a focus for being a full solution for all your reading needs. Setup your own server and share your reading collection with your friends and family!

volumes.description: Media library containing manga, comics and books.

docs.setup:
Access the webui at `<your-ip>:5000`. Follow the setup wizard on initial install.

The docker cli and compose yml samples provided list a single `/data` folder for the media, however, you can set up multiple mount points if you wish. For instance, you can set up 3 separate mountpoints named `/manga`, `/comics` and `/books`, each mapped to separate folders on host.

changelog.text: Rebase to Ubuntu Resolute. Enable jemalloc to reduce memory footprint.
Fix app file perms to prevent high uid.
